subject: MSA + portal onboarding: signer attribute normalization and PO metadata gating
messages:
From: Anjali Kumar <anjali.k@greenline.bio>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurex-ops@greenline.bio
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding + MSA redlines — PO metadata and delegated signer attributes

Hi Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks for taking this up. We're trying to finish vendor enrollment into Greenline's Ariba instance so we can send POs next week. A few blockers we hit during the registration run: 

- The portal requires a `poOrigin` attribute that we can't map from Redwood's Order Form. Need guidance on what Redwood will populate (platform vs. customer).
- Our finance team insists on the invoice remit name matching the signer attribute in the portal (delegatedSigner.displayName). Their vendor onboarding rejects mismatch.
- We have a handful of proposed redlines to the MSA (attached) around liability carve-outs and a one-off EDI clause.

Attached: MSA_GLB_redlines_v1.docx, OrderForm_PO-schema-v3.xlsx, portal-field-sample.json

Can you confirm: 
1) whether Redwood can populate poOrigin and delegatedSigner fields during order flow or if we need an order form amendment?
2) who at Redwood will own the MSA redline review so we can align signatures and timeline?

We're on a tight timetable — aim to accept our onboarding by 09/07 so our S&OP cycle can pick up POs.

Thanks,
Anjali Kumar
Procurement Ops | Greenline Biotech
anjali.k@greenline.bio
From: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Kumar <anjali.k@greenline.bio>, procurex-ops@greenline.bio
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines — PO metadata and delegated signer attributes

Hi Anjali —

Appreciate the details and attachments. Quick answers up-front: 
- We can provide a `poOrigin` tag but it requires a small order form schema update (two new optional fields). That is straightforward from our side; Karthik (cc'd) can run the change through activation.
- The delegated signer mapping is a bit stickier — legal needs to confirm that the value used for `delegatedSigner.displayName` is purely informational for the portal and not a contractually binding signature representation. Markus, can you confirm?

Next steps I propose: 
1) Karthik to scope the order form change, estimate ETA for Ariba mapping.
2) Markus to review the MSA redlines and provide comments / approval path; we'll track signature authority.
3) Marissa to coordinate evidence bundle for onboarding (W-9, SOC excerpt, KYC) once fields are aligned.

We're aiming for a single draft response to Greenline by EOD Thu 09/03. If anything cannot be done without an MSA amendment we'll flag that earlier.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
From: markus.klein@redwood.com <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Anjali Kumar <anjali.k@greenline.bio>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines — PO metadata and delegated signer attributes

Hannah / team —

I've reviewed the attached MSA redlines. High-level: 
- Liability carve-out language: we can accept one of the proposed edits but need to preserve the indemnity reciprocity clause. I'll create an annotated redline and highlight non-starters.
- EDI clause: minor drafting change required to align with our billing/legal operations — I'll mark it as acceptable pending a clean-up of the defined terms.
- Signer/displayName: this is not generally a contractually binding indicator unless parties expressly designate display name as "authorized signature" in the Order Form. We should avoid declaring displayName as the signature authority. 

Proposal: 
- I'll upload an annotated MSA (v2) by EOD 09/02.
- We should add a short Order Form exhibit clarifying that portal attributes (poOrigin, delegatedSigner.displayName) are informational and that signature authority is determined by the Signatory matrix in the Order Form. That avoids an MSA amendment for the majority of cases.

@Karthik — can you confirm the feasibility of adding an optional Exhibit B to Order Form schema? It would live in the onboarding payload and be non-breaking.

-MK
Markus Klein
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Anjali Kumar <anjali.k@greenline.bio>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines — PO metadata and delegated signer attributes

Thanks Markus —

Confirmed: adding an optional Exhibit B (order form exhibit for portal attributes) is straightforward and non-breaking. ETA for a dev package and test mapping into Ariba: 
- Spec and internal PR: 1 business day (09/03)
- QA + mapping to Ariba test tenant: 3 business days (complete by 09/08)

If Greenline can accept a temporary manual mapping during their pilot (we can push the portal attributes via a metadata feed), we can keep them in the production window for first PO. Otherwise we should plan for a short delay until 09/08 for fully automated mapping.

@Anjali — can you confirm whether Greenline will accept an interim manual feed? If yes, we'll proceed with Exhibit B and a manual mapping for the first week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Product Ops, Onboarding Integrations
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Anjali Kumar <anjali.k@greenline.bio>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding + MSA redlines — PO metadata and delegated signer attributes

Hi all —

Thanks — Greenline can accept a one-week manual metadata push for the initial POs. That works for our S&OP timeline. 

Please send the annotated MSA and proposed Exhibit B as soon as available so our legal team can sign off. We'll prepare the portal to accept the manual feed (procurex-ops@greenline.bio) and confirm once we receive the first mapping.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Anjali Kumar
Procurement Ops | Greenline Biotech
anjali.k@greenline.bio
